class.name: NNBlackboardKey
class.brief_description: One typed key declared by an [NNBlackboardSchema].
class.description: Declares a blackboard key, the [Variant] type its values must have, and an optional default. A [code]null[/code] value always means the key is absent, so it is accepted for every key regardless of [member value_type].

members.member: The value installed when [member has_default] is [code]true[/code] and the key is absent. It must match [member value_type]. [Array] and [Dictionary] defaults are deep-copied each time they are installed, so boards never share a default container.
Whether [member default_value] is installed into absent keys. See [member NNBlackboard.schema].
The blackboard key name. Must be non-empty and unique within its schema.

The required [Variant] type of non-[code]null[/code] values. Types are matched exactly, so [constant TYPE_INT] does not accept a [float]. [constant TYPE_NIL] (shown as [code]Any[/code] in the inspector) accepts every type.
